name: Atelier
description: Gather, organise and make: a library of photos, GIFs and videos with tags and albums, references and painting plans, and editors for photos, clips and GIFs.

commands.title: Save Current Search as Smart Album

mediaOrganizer.showCardTags.description: Show each item's tags on the grid card next to the date. Turn off to declutter the grid; tags remain visible in the detail view and sidebar.

mediaOrganizer.enableArtTools.description: Drawing and Painting Tools. Shows Daily Study, Practice Sessions and practice history in Atelier, for a workspace that holds reference photos. Off hides them; nothing is deleted.

mediaOrganizer.practiceDailyMinutes.description: Daily Study: minutes to draw the picture of the day.

mediaOrganizer.practiceChime.description: Play a short chime when a practice picture's time is up.

mediaOrganizer.practiceMirror.description: Start practice runs with the picture mirrored. Can be changed during a run.

mediaOrganizer.practiceGreyscale.description: Start practice runs with the picture in greyscale. Can be changed during a run.

mediaOrganizer.deleteMode.description: What Delete does. 'permanent' removes the items and their files at once (through Eraser when it is set up), after asking. 'trash' moves them to Trash without asking; Restore brings them back, and after 30 days they are removed the same way as a permanent delete.

mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderTempDir.description: Folder for temporary screen recordings before they are clipped. Must be inside the open workspace. Leave empty to use .parallx/extensions/media-organizer/recordings.

mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderAudio.description: Record audio into screen recordings. The sound is saved in the temp video, so MP4/WebM clip exports keep it (GIFs have no audio). 'system' captures whatever is playing on any output device (speakers, Bluetooth, USB, HDMI) via Windows loopback; 'mic' captures the default microphone; 'both' mixes the two into one track (narrate over what plays); 'off' disables audio.

mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderCountdown.description: Off by default: recording starts the moment you press Record. Set 3, 5 or 10 to count down inside the frame first, which gives you time to switch to the window you want to capture. Ctrl+Alt+R starts and stops a recording from any app while the frame is open; Ctrl+Alt+P pauses.

mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderShowCursor.description: Include the mouse pointer in the recording. Turn off for clean product clips; the cursor path is still tracked for Smart Zoom in the clip editor.

mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderFollowBox.description: Follow the box: while recording you can drag the frame around and the recording follows it, like a camera. The whole display is captured and the clip editor opens already cropped to the path you made, ready to fine-tune.

mediaOrganizer.upscaleTileSize.description: Tile size, in pixels, for the upscaler. 0 picks it from your GPU's memory (a 24 GB or larger card gets 1024). The tool's own automatic choice never exceeds 200 pixels, which leaves a big card mostly idle. Larger tiles are faster with identical output; if a size fails, the next smaller one is tried automatically.

mediaOrganizer.editJpegQuality.description: Image Editor: JPEG quality for Save As Copy, from 50 to 100. Higher keeps more detail and makes a larger file. PNG photos are saved as PNG and are not affected.
